titleStmt.title: The Woman Who Became a Loon

body.p: And there was one who became a loon. Her grandson went away in his kayak, and was driven away from the land. His grandmother began to shout, "Grandson, pull hard, pull hard!" The woman, while following her grandson, was {344} turned into a loon. When he was driven away from the land, his grandmother continued to cry from grief, because she longed for her grandson, who could not reach the land again.
